diagnosis: In the Bun.serve fetch handler, the WebSocket upgrade inspects the zoneId query parameter and attaches it to the socket context without validating that the authenticated user has clearance to monitor the specified building zone. Any authenticated employee or guest can subscribe to environmental telemetry, occupancy data, and sensor feeds from restricted or executive zones.
